hey there!

Hi 
My name is Rohit.

I have 7+ years of experience building and scaling cloud-native backend systems, distributed data pipelines, and financial data platforms. Proven ability to convert complex business requirements into production-grade, fault-tolerant architectures.

Hi 
My name is Rohit.

I have 7+ years of experience building and scaling cloud-native backend systems, distributed data pipelines, and financial data platforms. Proven ability to convert complex business requirements into production-grade, fault-tolerant architectures.

Currently working at Setu(pine labs)

setu at pine labs... the payments infrastructure play that's trying to digitize india's offline commerce. solid fintech move.

Nope

My profile is https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohitkdhanda/

setu... building the unified payments api that's powering india's digital commerce revolution. 7 years to senior engineer at a unicorn fintech - that trajectory makes sense.

what made you want to stay on the IC track instead of moving into engineering management? most people at your level get pushed toward leading teams.
I want to do more in depth work before i move to EM roles

makes sense. depth before breadth. most people rush into management and realize they miss actually building things.

how long you been working total?

7 years... that's solid senior territory. perfect timing to make a move before you get too comfortable.

what kind of role you looking for next?
Backend with scale, IC , litle bit of applied Ai, work lilfe balance, preferably remote, product based
